Judgment of 26 February 2007

Document Number 091-20070226-JUD-01-00-EN

Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide (Bosnia and Herzegovina v. Serbia and Montenegro)

The Court rejects the objections and affirms that it has jurisdiction, on the basis of Article IX of the Genocide Convention.

Finds that Serbia has not committed genocide, through its organs or persons whose acts engage its responsibility.

The Court finds that Serbia has violated its obligation under the Genocide Convention to prevent genocide in Srebrenica.

Serbia also failed fully to co-operate with the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia.
